ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio between low-intensity (black) pixels across the central fluke and high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black mass extending from the peduncle into the medial regions of both lobes; high-intensity white patches occupy the distal lateral surfaces, interspersed with discrete low-intensity circular clusters (mottling) throughout the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary containing high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) characterized by multiple sharp peaks and shallow valleys across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a generally convex geometric sweep from the medial region towards the distal tips, terminating in pointed, upward-tapering lobe ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous discrete, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters and ring-like patterns concentrated within the high-intensity white distal zones of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular pigmentation anomalies consistent with post-attachment sites of barnacles or other ectoparasites visible as high-contrast dark marks on a light background.
